deciding.under_dosed: The total of 35.85 L against 40 L planned is 89.6%, right at the 90% line, and no override is listed. The third cycle's plan of 0.1 looks like litres entered where mL was expected (a unit mismatch), which distorts a naive reading.
deciding.emitter_clogging: No pressure, valve-open or per-dripper evidence is present. The delivery is uniformly slightly low and one drain sample is just under the band, so clogging is unsupported but not excluded.
deciding.next_action: Delivery is uniformly about 10% low with no hardware evidence, which fits a dose change. The persistent shortfall with no pressure data makes a repair visit conceivable.
deciding.drain_deviation: A single drain sample of 19.5% against a 20-30% band is 0.5 points below. That is at the edge of the band.
deciding.off_plan_cycles: Cycles of 8.95 L are 10.5% under the 10 L plan (three cycles). The 9.0 L cycle is exactly 10% off and, since the unit-mismatched plan is unreadable, it counts or not. That gives 3 or 4 cycles.
